name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.announce.ManagerEditActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a server owner selects an announcement manager. It lets the owner change that person's permissions to post, edit the announcement channel, delete messages, manage members, and use emoji, or remove the person.
disableEffect: The server owner cannot change or remove individual announcement managers through the built-in QChat screen.
